placeholders.CALLER: the ordering subject; the only subject that may order, void before claimBy, or delegate
placeholders.PROGRAM: the programId (decimal); field program is pinned to it and `ran PROGRAM` reads run/program/PROGRAM, which the controller projects only for a re-executed, matching run claim (K-RAN)
placeholders.WINDOW: the challenge window in clock seconds: finalAt = clock/now + WINDOW on the answer edge
placeholders.NEG_WINDOW: -WINDOW (a canonical decimal; the template cannot negate a placeholder)
